{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/release-notes-xxxxx.md as part of documenting a mempool behavior change, which is excluded from documentation as the primary change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note updates follow code changes and do not make the PR a member of the docs category."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Mechanical removal of mempool options and removal reasons from src/kernel/mempool_options.h and src/kernel/mempool_removal_reason.*.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in src/kernel/ follow mechanically from removing mempool expiry logic rather than targeting the kernel boundary or external API."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Mempool label and changes mempool eviction policy by eliminating time-based transaction expiry and removing the entry_time index.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Eliminating time-based expiry prevents dropping mineable transactions that may have a fee-bumping descendant and saves one multi-index tree node per entry. As noted in issue #33510, age-based eviction is incentive-incompatible because it 'can drop still-mineable transactions, such as a low-feerate parent waiting on a fee-bumping child,' while removing the index reduces per-entry DynamicMemoryUsage() overhead."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes mempool_expiry.py and updates existing fuzz and functional tests to reflect the removal of expiry.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test changes follow directly from the removal of mempool expiry rather than modifying shared test runner or framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp and src/node/mempool_args.cpp solely to make -mempoolexpiry a no-op with a warning.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The argument parsing adjustments are incidental to deprecating the mempool expiry setting."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp and headers only to remove mempool expiry invocation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mempool policy changes are explicitly excluded from validation even when passing through validation files."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py to adapt to mempool behavior without modifying wallet code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Adapting a functional wallet test to changed mempool eviction rules does not constitute a wallet change."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
